svg.font-family: Prompt, "Noto Sans Thai", "Sukhumvit Set", system-ui, sans-serif
svg.title: Workforce Lab structure
svg.desc: Three doors computed in your browser (explore policy without sign-in; service and disease modules and my data with sign-in) feed assumptions or data into one validation step and calculation engine, whose labelled results are saved to a private workspace in your account; work reaches the research team only when you submit it, the team reviews it alongside planned automatic agency feeds, and accepted data is published as a new project data version that flows back into the engine.

g.aria-label: Explore policy: no data needed · no sign-in
Service & disease modules: your disease data · sign-in required
My data: replace project data · sign-in required

g.text: Your work reaches the team only when you submit it
